build_pixel_encoder: build a PixelEncoder convolutional network to encode pixel observations into feature vectors
build_carla_encoder: build a PixelEncoderCarla098 convolutional encoder with four conv layers for CARLA multi-camera observations
create_identity_encoder: create an IdentityEncoder that passes observations through unchanged for non-pixel state inputs
use_make_encoder: use make_encoder to instantiate a named encoder type such as pixel or identity by string key
tie_encoder_weights: tie convolutional layer weights between two encoders using the tie_weights helper function
